query: What learner needs and pain points appear in survey responses?

per_column.name: instructional_delivery_quality
per_column.rationale: Quality of instructional delivery is an environmental/teaching condition that may drive or explain learner pain points, but it is not itself an aspect OF the learner's needs or pain points. It describes the teacher/instruction, not a part of the learner-need concept.

per_column.name: engagement_barrier
per_column.rationale: Engagement barriers (low motivation, passive consumption, dropout) are a genuine sub-aspect of learner pain points -- a constitutive category of the difficulties learners experience.

per_column.name: hands_on_deficit_severity
per_column.rationale: The severity of a hands-on/practical-experience deficit is a specific type of learner need/pain point, capturing an aspect of what learners lack. It is a constitutive part of the concept.

per_column.name: positive_adaptation_type
per_column.rationale: Positive adaptations and benefits (innovative practice, flexibility, expanded access) are the OPPOSITE of needs and pain points. They capture gains/upsides, not aspects of learner difficulties, so they do not decompose the target concept.

judge.rationale: The concept 'learner needs and pain points' should be decomposed into constitutive types/dimensions of learner difficulties (e.g., engagement barriers, access/connectivity needs, content/pedagogical needs, social-emotional needs, assessment/feedback needs, practical/hands-on gaps). Only two of the four added columns are true facets: engagement_barrier and hands_on_deficit_severity. instructional_delivery_quality is an external teaching-condition predictor rather than an aspect of the learner's needs, and positive_adaptation_type captures benefits/upsides -- the semantic opposite of pain points. Mutual exclusivity among the qualifying facets is fairly good (engagement vs hands-on deficit are distinct), but overall coverage is weak: major expected pain-point facets such as access/connectivity, social-emotional/isolation, and content-comprehension needs are missing, and half the columns fail the part-of test.
